prior_exposure: Orsk current 2026 portal budget viewed; not part of historical pilot
Atlas panel and cluster outcomes previously examined
selection_rule: Three named case anchors; one opposite December-2023 partition label urban district in same statistical region, nearest absolute log 2023 population, ties by territory_id. No substitutions based on budget availability or values.

metrics.expense_per_person: executed expense RUB / source population at start of same year; not mean annual population
metrics.tax_nontax_share: executed tax and non-tax revenue / executed total revenue; explicitly named measure, not legal definition of own revenues
metrics.deficit_to_revenue: (executed expense - executed revenue) / executed revenue; signed, surplus negative
metrics.functional_shares: executed top-level expense functions / executed total expense, only with checked hierarchy; no parent plus child sum

acceptance: Municipality and fiscal year explicit in original official annual execution report or approved decision; source units explicit; plan never treated as execution; source code/authority crosswalk reviewed. Preserve NULL and reject nonpositive denominators.
analysis: Municipality-year rows, 12 planned observations. Common observed masks; paired year changes and within-region contrasts only descriptive. Partition labels are December-2023 labels, not stable identity IDs. No causal flood estimate, p-values, adjusted-regression claims, economic PASS, or forecast input. Strong population imbalance disclosed.
vintage: Decision date != known online availability; retrieved_at now, available_at/vintage null unless separately evidenced. Historical figures remain retrospective.
missing_policy: Unretrievable or unverified report/metric remains NULL, logged separately; no replacement city, no regional amount copied to municipality.
stop_rule: One bounded pilot, retain priority and 5-Oct new-data cutoff / 7-8-Oct final assembly. Publish incomplete coverage honestly.
